name: io.github.GeiserX/atlassian-browser-mcp
title: Atlassian (browser SSO)
description: Jira and Confluence Server/Data Center behind SSO, authenticated through your own browser session: every upstream mcp-atlassian tool, no API token

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Jira Server/Data Center instance (set the one you use; Jira-only and Confluence-only setups work)

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Confluence Server/Data Center instance

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide every write tool (create, update, delete, transition, upload, restrictions)

environmentVariables.name: ENABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of tool names; unset exposes every tool

environmentVariables.name: ATLASSIAN_BROWSER_AUTH_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip the browser session and use upstream token auth instead

environmentVariables.name: ATLASSIAN_STORAGE_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the saved browser session (cookie jar) written by atlassian-cli login; defaults to the current directory
